construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch for this isolated build

input.guided: completed_steps: ordered prefix of consent/profile/preferences; responses keyed by step
input.profile: Nonblank display_name and region; metadata only
input.preferences: Unique case-insensitive topic/positive finite weight interests; exclude_topics; exact exclude_ids; max_recommendations 1..50
input.catalog: At most 100 uniquely identified items with title, unique case-insensitive topics, and 1..100 passages each
input.passage: Item-local unique id, synthetic:// source, nonblank text of at most 10000 characters
input.research: Nonblank searchable query and integer max_findings 1..100

shared_schema.output: schema_version, fixture_label, status, guided, interests, normal; incomplete onboarding uses needs_setup and null downstream stages
shared_schema.errors: One stdout JSON object with schema_version, status:error and error message; exit 2
shared_schema.validation: One shared validation layer enforces input types, field sets, bounds, duplicates, prerequisites and deterministic grounded stage handoffs; bool is not accepted as numeric input

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Validated readiness, copied profile, weighted preferences, explicit exclusions and recommendation limit
cross_stage_handoffs.gate: Consent accepted and all three prerequisite-ordered steps completed; partial valid setup returns progress without running discovery

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Validated ordered recommendation IDs, constrained by preference scores and exclusions
cross_stage_handoffs.gate: Retrieval searches only the recommended items, never the full catalog

behavior.guided: Tracks completed/remaining steps, fraction and next required step; validates supplied responses even if not yet marked complete
behavior.interests: Case-insensitive topic equality, summed declared weights, exclusions before ranking, positive matches only; score descending then item ID ascending
behavior.explanations: Explicit matching topic/weight evidence and deterministic explanations, grounded solely in declared preferences and item topics
behavior.research: Unicode word-token overlap with query; score is count of distinct matching query terms; ties follow recommendation rank then passage ID
behavior.citations: Entire retrieved passages are extractive findings with exact source, item ID, passage ID and half-open Python Unicode character offsets
behavior.no_evidence: Empty findings and no_evidence:true; no invented content or fallback outside recommendations
behavior.cli: UTF-8 input, duplicate JSON keys rejected, one ASCII-safe JSON output object; valid partial onboarding exits 0
behavior.determinism: No randomness, live inference, external retrieval or mutation of caller input

included: Integrated prerequisite-driven onboarding, personalized discovery and extractive research
Strict shared input and stage-boundary validation
Exact traceable citations and exclusion propagation
Standard-library unit and subprocess CLI tests
excluded: Live LLMs and optional model hooks
Networks, external research and source verification
Semantic search, stemming, stop-word removal and abstractive summaries

test_outcomes.coverage: All stages, prerequisite gating, grounded rankings, exclusion propagation, exact citations, deterministic ties, Unicode offsets, empty results, bounds and type errors, tampered handoffs, CLI usage/file/decoding/JSON errors and excessive nesting
